name: hero-into-ai-1440
caption: Phase 1 wraps the heading inside the page margin and enters the AI graph by a long flat run. The proposal still passes the heading on the margin side, the only clear way to the left node, but its flat run sits mid-gap and it enters through a 45° chamfer.

name: ai-into-automation-1440
caption: Phase 1 makes a fussy 68 px jog, then squeezes between the paragraph and the trigger. The proposal drops once and arrives on a diagonal.

name: automation-exit-1440
caption: Phase 1 runs 254 px along the bottom card and through the dot canvas; production grazes the card's corner. The proposal drops clear, then crosses in the middle of the gap.

name: method-1440
caption: Phase 1 squeezes a two-turn bracket between neighbouring plates. The proposal drops beside the plate and enters the next plinth from the side, with one turn.

name: hero-into-ai-1024
caption: Phase 1's flat run sits against the pyramid, it wraps the heading, and it hooks into the AI graph. The proposal centres its crossing and enters through a chamfer.

name: automation-to-software-1024
caption: Here the crossing sits in the middle of the gap, clear of both the drawing above and the grey band's edge below.

name: tablet-services-768
caption: Phase 1 runs flat right under the pyramid, then makes edge-hugging U-turns that switch back across the page into the top ports. The proposal uses long 45° runs, straight drops and chamfered entries.

name: tablet-method-768
caption: Method at 768 px: the brackets between neighbouring plates become single-turn L routes.

name: phone-services-390
caption: Phase 1 switches between the two screen edges and crosses the column at every plate, ending each crossing in a hook. The proposal keeps one spine down the left margin and branches into every plate from it.

name: phone-method-390
caption: Phone Method: Phase 1 drops onto each plinth from above after crossing the column. The proposal comes off the spine and enters the plinth from the side.
